name: chr3b
strain_assembly: Chinese Spring IWGSC RefSeq v2.1 — chromosome 3B
key_challenge: Cross-subgenome homeolog ambiguity (~95% identity between A/B/D subgenomes), highly repetitive

reference.notes: VERIFY: confirm v2.1 chromosome 3B URL at URGI before download. v1.0 GenBank accession GCA_900519105.1 is provided as fallback but v2.1 is the current standard. chr3B is the recommended contained option — keeps homeolog ambiguity tractable without requiring the full 17 Gb hexaploid.

download.command: wget -q 'https://wheat-urgi.versailles.inra.fr/Seq-Repository/Assemblies' -O index.html && grep -oP 'href="[^"]*3B[^"]*\.fa\.gz"' index.html | head -1 | grep -oP '(?<=href=")[^"]+' | xargs wget -q -O chr3B.fa.gz && gunzip chr3B.fa.gz && mv chr3B.fa reference.fasta && rm -f index.html

simulation.command: art_illumina -ss HS25 -i ../reference/reference.fasta -p -l 150 -f 10 -rs {rng_seed} -o reads && gzip reads1.fq reads2.fq && mv reads1.fq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads2.fq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Lower coverage for large chromosome. art_illumina used for HiSeq platform error model (HS25). Map reads against full hexaploid reference if available to capture homeolog mismapping.

truth.simulated: art_illumina read name encodes true origin; parse with custom comparator or paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Homeologous subgenomes (A, B, D) share ~95% identity — reads from one subgenome frequently seed to another. This is the core polyploid stressor. Map against full hexaploid reference (all 3 subgenomes) for maximum diagnostic value.

curation.notes: VERIFY download URL at URGI before acquisition. The wget command above may need updating if URGI restructures their file listing.
